about: compiler/front: Data-Oriented SoA frontend package/workspace loading, module manifest & go.mod MVS resolution, std index, asset/embed/gittree admission, and warm/check cache coordination (SELFHOST-FRONTEND-LOADER).

mutants.name: selfhost-front-tables-programtext-unsorted
mutants.rule: FormatProgramText encodes entries sorted by Rel so program text is order invariant.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-stdindex-admits-prelude
mutants.rule: DiscoverStdIndex must not index the implicit prelude directory as an importable std package.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-modfile-missing-module-unreported
mutants.rule: ParseErgoMod must emit a diagnostic when no module directive is present.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-modfile-allows-std-prefix
mutants.rule: Ergo module paths cannot start with reserved top-level names std or prelude.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-modfile-allows-reserved-map
mutants.rule: Map directives must reject patterns that match reserved files such as *.ergo or ergo.mod.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-gomod-wildcard-beats-exact
mutants.rule: Exact-version go.mod replace directives must take priority over wildcard replaces.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-gomod-hash1-unsorted
mutants.rule: Hash1 must sort directory entries by Rel before computing the dirhash listing.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-gomod-mvs-skips-upgrade
mutants.rule: MVS must upgrade module versions whenever a transitive requirement specifies a higher semver.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-workspace-admit-testdata
mutants.rule: AdmitFolder must exclude testdata directories from workspace and package discovery.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-workspace-skip-overbroad
mutants.rule: Workspace skip prefixes must match on slash boundaries rather than bare string prefixes.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-workspace-cycle-unrejected
mutants.rule: ParseWorkFile must diagnose task dependency cycles in ergo.work.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-assets-stem-wrong-prefix
mutants.rule: AssetStem must extract only the wildcard stem between prefix and suffix so companion expansion preserves extension.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-embed-ignores-all-prefix
mutants.rule: The all: embed prefix must enable admission of dot and underscore entries.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-embed-allows-multi-single
mutants.rule: Single-file embeds must diagnose patterns matching more than one file.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-gittree-ignores-symlinks
mutants.rule: GitTreeFS Stat and ReadFile must follow mode 120000 symlink blobs.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-loader-cycle-unrejected
mutants.from:
if targetState == VisitActive {
			let msg = formatImportCycle(st.scratch.StackNames, res.importPath)
mutants.to:
if false && targetState == VisitActive {
			let msg = formatImportCycle(st.scratch.StackNames, res.importPath)
mutants.rule: LoadProgram must diagnose package import cycles with an import cycle chain.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-loader-nested-module-walked
mutants.rule: Discovering packages within a module stops at subdirectories holding a nested ergo.mod.

mutants.name: selfhost-front-cache-ignores-listing-change
mutants.rule: InputsFresh must verify directory listing digests so adding files invalidates warm cache hits.
